producers.globalTimingRule: Native character task clock may pause under hitlag; do not require global elapsed time exactly 14.
producers.factSemantics: Zero at task entry; one after the original single QueueAttack call completes.
producers.snapshotNote: The earlier snap in Skill supplies shield HP. The initial damage still uses the original QueueAttack at task execution, not QueueAttackWithSnap.

producers.factSemantics: Zero at callback entry; one only in the existing guard-positive branch before explodeShield.
producers.ownerRule: Timer fallback is ability-producer-owned when there is no active shield hook. Do not invent or attach a shield instance from timer/frame equality.
producers.pendingRule: At C4+ the pending timer remains part of finite damage scope even if the shield already broke or was overwritten; require its actual completed branch.

explosion.formula: Unchanged native multiplier 4, Geo element, existing hitlag and defense-halt flags.
explosion.ownerRule: Generic expiry/overwrite/damage hook uses the exact old E shield instance. The separate timer path retains producer ownership and no fabricated shield cause.

hooks.ordering: Native expiration callback runs before removal; explosion resets shared shieldTimer before later core timer task.
Old shield explodes inside original Shields.Add before new shield installation. Skill sets the new shared shieldTimer after Add returns.

hooks.nativePath: noelleShield.OnDamage -> Tmpl.OnDamage; explodeShield only when !ok && Cons>=4
hooks.ordering: Explosion occurs before generic handler removal and OnShieldBreak event.

writes: explodeShield sets shieldTimer=0 before queueing damage
reads: Only the C4 core timer guard compares shieldTimer to Core.F
timerAudit.nativeOrder: Core.Tick calls Player.Tick before Core.Tasks.Run; Player.Tick executes Shields.Tick before character.Tick.
timerAudit.normalExpiryConsequence: C4 native OnExpire normally resets timer before the same-frame +720 core task, whose actual branch is then zero. This is an observed branch requirement, not a skipped task or assumed cleanup.
timerAudit.replacementConsequence: Native old-shield OnOverwrite explosion resets timer, then Skill writes new timer. Earlier task guards still execute later; their exact 0/1 facts govern ownership.
timerAudit.sameFrameRule: Do not infer timer ownership by matching equal frame keys or configured lifetimes.

a1Exclusion.constructor: direct plain shield.Tmpl in a1, not noelleShield/newShield
a1Exclusion.nativeBirthSite: untagged all-Add observation remains outside noelle.skill.shield
a1Exclusion.note: No A1 source edit; its HP formula, event guards, active target and passive lifecycle remain separate.

callbackAudit: skillHealCB checks enemy, closure-local done, current NoelleSkill shield, probability/C1 state, then existing RNG; it queues healing only and no damage.
skillHealCB is also used by normal/charged attacks but those callbacks and their healing are outside this E intrinsic damage component.
newShield has only the E Skill caller; A1 does not reuse it.
explodeShield has exactly four source callsites: the C4 core timer plus custom shield OnExpire, OnOverwrite, and broken OnDamage.
collectionRequirements: Require exactly one E birth with creationSiteId noelle.skill.shield and exact invocation identity.
Require one initial character producer with the original single Breastplate queue and terminal targets; check character scheduling without equating it to a global +14 deadline.
For C4+ require the one actual +720 core timer producer and its source-known 0/1 count; do not silently omit a pending or positive timer.
Require actual native terminal lifecycle and hook receipts for the E-born shield; configured expiry alone is not observed termination.
Select terminal explosion damage by exact shield instance and allowed hook cause; exclude A1/other shields and later E births.
If a timer branch emits an explosion without an active shield hook, count it through that timer producer rather than attaching it to an assumed shield.
Keep shield-owned queued attacks out of new invocation/producer root census, especially old-shield overwrite explosion during a subsequent E.
Do not normalize the Classic/stellar shield element difference or add cleanup/removal behavior.
scopeNotes: Healing, A1 passive shield, A4 cooldown reduction, Burst state, normal/charged attacks, crystallize shields and downstream reactions are outside this intrinsic E damage component.
All gameplay formulas, snapshot timing, RNG draws, task clocks, delays, state mutation order and queue arguments stay unchanged.
